gbm_population_evidence.quote: Prior histopathologically proven diagnosis of World Health Organization (WHO) grade IV glioblastoma, OR histopathologically proven diagnosis of gliosarcoma, OR molecular diagnosis of glioblastoma per c-IMPACT-NOW criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a phase II study of the combination of the GITR agonist monoclonal antibody INCAGN01876, the anti-PD1 monoclonal antibody INCMGA00012, and stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) for recurrent Glioblastoma (GBM).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants must have glial tumor that is recurrent following prior first-line radiation therapy

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Arm B (Cohort B) is a surgical arm (N=16) that will allow for evaluation of the effects on the tumor immune microenvironment of INCMGA00012, INCAGN01876, and SRS.

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] INCMGA00012 (other names: PD-1 inhibitor, PD1): 500mg IV neoadjuvant treatment; 500 mg adjuvant treatment

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody (Incyte development code INCMGA00012)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: PD-1 inhibitor; hypothesised to stimulate a robust anti-tumor immune response

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] INCAGN01876 (other names: Anti-GITR agonist, GITR): 300mg IV neoadjuvant treatment; 300 mg adjuvant treatment
the GITR agonist monoclonal antibody INCAGN01876

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational anti-GITR agonist monoclonal antibody (INCAGN01876; written INCAGN1876 in official title)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: GITR agonist; hypothesised to stimulate a robust anti-tumor immune response

source_quote.quote: Tumor O-6-methylguanine-deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) methyltransferase (MGMT) methylation status must be available from any prior GBM tumor specimen

coder_notes: Active moiety for INCAGN01876 written as first appearing in the record (official title spells it INCAGN1876); registered intervention name is INCAGN01876. SRS is registered as a Drug intervention but is radiotherapy, so not listed as an agent. MGMT: entry requires only that methylation status be available (any value), not a specific status; coded eligibility, adjudicator may prefer to treat as non-selective. cns5_terminology coded historical: histological 'WHO grade IV glioblastoma' accepted without IDH requirement and secondary GBM from lower-grade glioma allowed; IDH-wildtype named only for the cIMPACT-NOW molecular diagnosis route (EGFR amplification, +7/-10, TERT promoter as GBM-defining features, not listed as biomarkers). Target engagement coded yes on the stated Cohort B evaluation of tumour immune microenvironment after neoadjuvant treatment; no formal registered outcome for it.
